tasks.label: setup-env: создать .venv и установить зависимости
tasks.command: python -m venv .venv; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt

tasks.label: run-tests: прогон функциональных тестов
tasks.command: $failed = 0; foreach ($t in 'test_fixes','test_tools_passthrough','test_anonymize_only','test_file_parser','test_ner_quality') { Write-Host "=== $t ==="; & .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe "anonymizer_proxy\tests\$t.py"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $failed = 1; Write-Host "FAILED: $t" } }; if ($failed -ne 0) { exit 1 }
